cut_over_plan.step: Pull the Mailchimp export (export date). Import the 4,057 suppressions into Klaviyo with its suppressed-profiles importer.
Rerun the event check on 2026-10-31 to 2026-11-06. Go or no-go: if Viewed Product or the domain still fails, move D.

Create the Newsletter list (fix below). Import the 18,838 subscribed contacts with the mapped fields; no flow is live on the list yet. Turn on the Shopify subscriber sync after the import, then check 5 conflict profiles. Ramp campaigns start on Klaviyo to the 6,904 in Clicked in last 6 months, volumes from email-deliverability-auditor; each campaign goes out from one platform only.
Build 4 segments, 7 templates, 2 forms (unpublished) and 4 flows (draft).
Unschedule Holiday yarn drop in Mailchimp and schedule it in Klaviyo for 2026-11-20.
cut_over_plan.proof: no Mailchimp campaign scheduled after D

cut_over_plan.step: In one hour: publish the Klaviyo footer form and pop-up and remove the Mailchimp form code; pause Mailchimp Abandoned cart, Product retargeting and Birthday and set the Klaviyo flows live; set the Klaviyo welcome live. Pull members changed to unsubscribed or cleaned since the export date and suppress them in Klaviyo.
Pause Mailchimp Welcome new subscribers after its 7-day drain. Second delta suppression pull.
Export Mailchimp reports, final delta suppression pull, disconnect Shopify from Mailchimp, close the Mailchimp account.
